entries.message: Translate automatically without pop-ups, turn off translation offers, and manage download and location permissions from site controls without saving accidental blocks
Check and repair macOS permissions in General settings, verify download folder access, and stop requesting passkey access during ordinary browsing
Keep the tab you select while Crest starts instead of returning to the Start Page when extensions finish loading
Reduce pauses during iCloud sync by avoiding repeated sorting work in large browsing histories
Choose which downloaded languages translate automatically and their destination languages in General settings
Gray out language mappings while automatic translation is off and restore their controls when it is enabled
Keep dragging links into Peek available after following an in-page link
Allow Apple's submission-supported Xcode 27 build in the Cloud archive guard
